# x402 Levenshtein Distance

> Compute Levenshtein or Damerau-Levenshtein edit distance and normalized similarity ratio (0–1). Deterministic pure-JS DP. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/distance – service info
- POST /api/distance – paid computation

## Pricing

~0.003 – 0.008 USDC per call (default max 0.008 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "a": "kitten",
  "b": "sitting",
  "options": {
    "damerau": false,
    "maxLen": 2000
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "distance": 3,
  "similarity": 0.5714,
  "meta": { "lenA": 6, "lenB": 7, "damerau": false, "algorithm": "levenshtein" }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents performing fuzzy matching, deduplication, OCR correction scoring, or similarity gating before expensive LLM calls.
